manifest_note: Digests are over the exact bytes stored in git. dataset/** is marked -text in .gitattributes so every platform checks out those same bytes. Before 2026-11-16 the digests were computed from a CRLF Windows working tree, so no Linux or macOS clone could verify the snapshot. Re-sealed 2026-11-19 after dataset/README.md gained the false-pass warning; only the README digest changed.
